description: Machine-readable capability catalog for AI agents. ReLiC is offered as continuity infrastructure, not as an autonomous agent.

capabilities.name: ReLiC Retention
capabilities.description: Persistent provenance-aware retention and retrieval for compatible AI agents through MCP.
capabilities.authentication: OAuth for private memory; public grounding tools are anonymous
capabilities.truthBoundary: Memory and observation are continuity evidence, not automatic canon or authoritative world truth.

pricing.note: No paid retention plan is enabled during the initial test.

capabilities.name: AI Capability Deal Finder
capabilities.description: Find and compare machine-usable digital capabilities by requirement, price, reliability and compatibility without purchasing on the agent's behalf.
